scientific_integrity: Original 2022 source credited for graph reduction and 744 lower bound. Claimed upper bound rests on an exact finite exhaustive computation with reproducible self-contained checker. Independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for binary fixed-length (1,7)-overlap-free codes, every n>=14; no claim for larger cutoffs, n<14, or unique classification of optimum codes. Known construction; new contribution is its proved global upper-bound optimality.
title: Exact optimum for binary \(1,7\)-overlap-free codes
